highlights: Recommend the global runtime with project-local state, and add an explicit migration path for legacy project-local installs.
Preserve user tasks, progress, memory, research, project facts, README, package files, and modified or user-authored files during migration and removal.
Route `wf-browser` through BrowserOS Neo and require users to download BrowserOS Neo themselves when it is unavailable.
Keep global update, project task routing, weekly task archiving, wf-ui, and wf-search behavior covered by the release validation suite.
Harden `/wf-search` rendering: square brackets in all text output are HTML-escaped so escaped-bracket Markdown link injection (`[x\]](https://evil.example)`) can never survive as a clickable link.
Harden `/wf-search` save-path validation: dangling symlink/junction segments of `Harness/research` are now resolved through realpath and rejected instead of being treated as plain directory names.
Harden `/wf-search` stdin handling: `--input -` enforces the 1 MiB limit during the read (64 KiB bounded chunks) instead of buffering the entire stream first.
Found by independent cross-review of the released 0.9.3; full verification matrix (75 wf-search tests, 458-test suite, mirror parity, version checksums) re-run on the fix candidate.

agent.updateReportRequired: After apply/finalize, tell the user the version, safe/new/conflict counts, validation results, and the core releaseHighlights from this update.
agent.conflictPolicy: Use the script for SAFE/NEW/adopted files. For each CONFLICT file, compare local content with templateHint/remoteUrl, then record the decision with --accept-local, --accept-merged, or --accept-template. Do not hand-edit Harness/.harness-version.
